name: Fred Rogers
description: Through Mister Rogers' Neighborhood, Fred Rogers taught generations of children that their feelings matter and that every person deserves dignity, patience, and care.
reflection: Not all heroes wear capes. Some wear cardigans.

imageCredit.author: Terry Arthur (press photo, 1982)
imageCredit.license: Public domain in the United States (per Commons)

name: LeVar Burton
description: As the host of Reading Rainbow, LeVar Burton opened the door to books for countless children and reminded them that curiosity can take you anywhere.
reflection: A good story can open a thousand doors.

name: Dolly Parton
description: Beyond her music, Dolly Parton has helped children discover the joy of reading through her Imagination Library, which gifts books to young readers.
reflection: Sometimes the greatest gift is a chance to dream.

name: Steve Irwin
description: Steve Irwin shared an infectious love of wildlife and inspired people around the world to care about animals and the places they call home.
reflection: Caring begins when we learn to see the wonder around us.

name: Bob Ross
description: With a gentle voice and a paintbrush, Bob Ross made creativity feel welcoming, showing people that making something beautiful does not require perfection.
reflection: A little encouragement can change what someone believes is possible.

imageCredit.author: Unknown photographer
imageCredit.license: Public domain in the United States (per Commons)

name: Jim Henson
description: Jim Henson brought warmth, humor, and empathy to generations through the Muppets and the stories they told.
reflection: Sometimes a little imagination helps us see the good in everyone.

imageCredit.author: Bernard Gotfryd (Library of Congress)
imageCredit.license: Public domain (no known copyright restrictions, per Commons)

name: Weird Al Yankovic
description: Through playful parodies and joyful performances, Weird Al Yankovic has made generations laugh without taking himself too seriously.
reflection: A little silliness can make a difficult day lighter.

name: Patrick Stewart
description: Patrick Stewart has used his voice and public platform to support charitable causes and speak about the importance of compassion and dignity.
reflection: Strength and tenderness can belong to the same person.

name: Steve Wozniak
description: Steve Wozniak helped bring personal computing into everyday life and has championed hands-on learning and creativity in technology.
reflection: The best inventions give other people room to create.

name: Betty White
description: Betty White brought laughter to generations of viewers and devoted years of advocacy and support to animal welfare.
reflection: A joyful life can make room for every kind of creature.

name: Keanu Reeves
description: Keanu Reeves has earned affection for his thoughtful public demeanor and quiet support for charitable causes alongside a long acting career.
reflection: Kindness does not need to announce itself.

name: Brendan Fraser
description: Brendan Fraser has connected with audiences through heartfelt performances and a career marked by persistence, warmth, and a celebrated return to film.
reflection: There is always room for another chapter.

name: Julie Andrews
description: Julie Andrews has shared music, stories, and a love of reading with generations of families through stage, film, and children’s books.
reflection: A story or song can stay with someone for a lifetime.

imageCredit.author: 20th Century Fox (publicity photo, c. 1965)
imageCredit.license: Public domain in the United States (per Commons)

name: Dick Van Dyke
description: Dick Van Dyke has spent decades making audiences smile through comedy, music, dance, and an unmistakable sense of play.
reflection: You never have to outgrow the joy of being playful.

name: David Attenborough
description: David Attenborough has brought the natural world into homes around the globe and inspired countless people to care about the planet.
reflection: When we pay attention to nature, wonder follows.

name: Henry Winkler
description: Henry Winkler has spoken openly about dyslexia and helped young readers feel seen through his books and advocacy for learning differences.
reflection: The way you learn does not define what you can become.

name: Jack Black
description: Jack Black has shared his exuberance for music, comedy, and creativity, inviting audiences to embrace their playful side.
reflection: Enthusiasm has a way of spreading.

name: Cyndi Lauper
description: Cyndi Lauper has paired a distinctive creative voice with advocacy for LGBTQ+ young people facing homelessness.
reflection: Everyone deserves somewhere they can belong.

name: Carol Burnett
description: Carol Burnett opened doors for generations of comedians and gave audiences moments of connection through warmth, wit, and laughter.
reflection: Sharing a laugh can make us feel less alone.

imageCredit.author: Unknown photographer (publicity photo, 1974)
imageCredit.license: Public domain in the United States (per Commons)

name: Paul McCartney
description: Paul McCartney has connected generations through music and has supported charitable and humanitarian causes across a long career.
reflection: A melody can bring strangers together.
